title: Bump chart of changing ranks
intent: Show how the rank of five products changes across seven annual snapshots.

source.title: Observable Plot line mark and bump curve

ai.create: Create a bump chart from tidy annual product values by ranking products within each year, drawing one curved line per product, and directly labeling the final rank.
ai.maintain: Add another annual snapshot while retaining descending rank semantics, stable series colors, inferred channels, and labels at the newest observation.
